The issue is clear. The `save_vocabulary` method in `src/transformers/models/t5/tokenization_t5_fast.py` doesn't handle the case where `self.vocab_file` is `None` (i.e., when the tokenizer was created without a SentencePiece file). It calls `os.path.abspath(self.vocab_file)` which raises a `TypeError` when `self.vocab_file` is `None`.

The fix needs to add a check for `self.vocab_file` before attempting to copy/compare it.
